claims.text: For patients who can't tolerate dapsone: 500 mg orally 3 times a day, up to 2000 mg 3 times a day (sulfasalazine is an alternative)
claims.quote: Sulfapyridine 500 mg orally 3 times a day (or, alternatively, sulfasalazine) is an alternative for patients who cannot tolerate dapsone. Doses of sulfapyridine up to 2000 mg orally 3 times a day can be used.

claims.text: May cause agranulocytosis: CBC at baseline, weekly for 4 weeks, every 2 to 3 weeks for 8 weeks, then every 12 to 16 weeks
claims.quote: Sulfapyridine may cause agranulocytosis. Patients receiving dapsone or sulfapyridine should have a baseline complete blood count (CBC). CBC is then done weekly for 4 weeks, then every 2 to 3 weeks for 8 weeks, and every 12 to 16 weeks thereafter.
